description: Java class defining MonkeyKeyEvent, a subclass of MonkeyEvent, representing key events for the Android Monkey testing tool. It includes methods for constructing, modifying, and injecting key events into the system.

classes.name: MonkeyKeyEvent
classes.description: Represents a key event in the Android Monkey testing framework, capable of being constructed from parameters or a KeyEvent object, and injected into the system.

methods.name: MonkeyKeyEvent
methods.description: Constructor initializing a MonkeyKeyEvent with action and keyCode.

methods.name: MonkeyKeyEvent
methods.description: Constructor initializing a MonkeyKeyEvent with detailed parameters including timestamps, device info, and scan code.

methods.name: MonkeyKeyEvent
methods.description: Constructor initializing a MonkeyKeyEvent from an existing KeyEvent object.

methods.name: getKeyCode
methods.description: Returns the key code associated with the event.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns the action (press/release) of the key event.

methods.name: getDownTime
methods.description: Returns the time when the key was pressed down.

methods.name: getEventTime
methods.description: Returns the time when the event occurred.

methods.name: setDownTime
methods.description: Sets the down time for the key event; throws exception if initialized from KeyEvent.

methods.name: setEventTime
methods.description: Sets the event time; throws exception if initialized from KeyEvent.

methods.name: isThrottlable
methods.description: Indicates if the event can be throttled; true if action is ACTION_UP.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Injects the key event into the system via InputManager, returning success or failure.
